title: Plant Incubation Apparatuses and Related Methods
abstract: A plant incubation apparatus includes upper and lower chambers separated by a partition. Plant roots may be positioned in the lower chamber, and sensors collect information about plant properties and environmental parameters. The apparatus may monitor conditions such as light, temperature, and nutrient solution properties, and use a processor to assess plant conditions and adjust settings.
claims: The patent describes plant incubation apparatuses and related methods involving plant chambers, sensors, monitoring of plant or environmental conditions, and associated control functions.
